- Courtroom View Network (CVN) Source Courtroom View Network (CVN) How to Cite the Source Courtroom View Network Description Courtroom View Network (CVN) delivers live and on-demand video and editorial coverage of high-stakes civil litigation. Since 2004, the CVN video library has grown to include over 1,000 trials with tens of thousands of hours of fully indexed, searchable video. Unless otherwise stated, all trials are fully indexed with evidence slides so that you see exactly what was presented at trial. Users can search by trial name, attorney, judge, expert witness, and more. Premium CVN docket, gavel-to-gavel CVN Video, and CVN Training services are provided as subscriptions, which provide access to trials, hearings, oral arguments, and other courtroom video that may be streamed over the Internet. Users may watch proceedings Live, or On Demand, on their personal computer, depending on the subscription. Video may also be viewed on DVD-ROM (Computer Only, playable in the CVN Player with synched digital exhibits) or DVD. When ordering DVDs, subscribers select proceedings at on CVN.com and receive them on DVD by U.S. mail or Fedex. CVN Video proceedings are designated into two categories: CVN Live Current Cases and CVN On Demand Archive Cases. CVN Live Current Cases are proceedings that are upcoming, in progress, or concluded within the last 30 days. These proceedings are available in one or all of the following formats: Live, On Demand, on DVD. A CVN Live subscription provides video access to all Current Cases, with premium events available only under a CVN Live Premium subscription. CVN On Demand Archive Cases are proceedings that concluded more than 30 days ago, and where the video has undergone a quality assessment, quality improvement where possible, and video chapters are logged for better browsing and navigation. These proceedings are available in these formats: DVD, On Demand. These proceedings are sold in a discount subscription and available through an annual CVN On Demand subscription. CVN's Editorial team finds trials using a variety of sources, including dockets and news articles. They also receive many tips and they poll subscribers to find out what they want to see. List of cases covered Time Period Covered 2004 - present Access Must purchase subscription Contact: #Information Resources Cost Video Library access online: https://cvn.com/pricing ($99 per month for 1 person, $399 per month for up to 6). This only includes online viewing of completed trials. Premium Live Access or Digital Downloads: Pricing for live and on-demand access to a single case is below. Each account or user would be able to log in from one device at a time. 1-3 accounts - $600 per day 4-6 accounts - $800 per day 7-9 accounts - $1000 per day Firm Wide - $1200 per day Downloadable files in addition to any option above would be $400 per day. Downloadable files would be delivered within 36 hours of each day ending. Live and on-demand access for the firm to all trials we cover would be $3,000 per month on an annual contract. Important Notes CVN focuses on civil litigation. Memberships automatically renew unless cancelled, which can be done on the Account page. Video Library memberships do not include access to live trials. CVN will periodically offer certain live trials to our members depending on interest. We would need to negotiate a license with CVN if we were to get a full subscription. AI Restrictions Parent company Remote Counsel (RC) grants users a limited license to access and make personal use of CVN and not to download (other than page caching) or modify it, or any portion of it, except with express written consent of RC. This license does not include any resale or commercial use of CVN.com or its contents; any collection and use of any product listings, descriptions, or prices; any derivative use of CVN.com or its contents; any downloading or copying of account information for the benefit of another merchant; or any use of data mining, robots, or similar data gathering and extraction tools. CVN.com and any portion of it content may not be reproduced, duplicated, copied, sold, resold, visited, or otherwise exploited for any commercial purpose without express written consent of RC. - Tick History (DataScope) Source ​Tick History (Datascope) How to Cite the Source ​Refinitiv Description Tick History is an archive of historical tick data drawn from our real time content. It’s built on a platform that provides on-demand delivery of our universe of 70m active and retired securities. It comes with a web based user interface, and a REST API providing efficient programmatic access to the full content and capabilities of the product. Tick History covers OTC and exchange-traded instruments, from more than 500 trading venues and third-party contributors. It gives users access to historical tick-level global data across all asset classes, letting them build and back-test trading strategies, as well as perform quantitative research and analysis, transaction cost analysis, and market surveillance. Data coverage goes back as far as 1996, with a standardized naming convention based on RIC (Reuters Instrument Code) symbology that helps lower your data management cost. Time Period Covered ​1996-present Access ​Web Cost ​Varies Contact (within CR or Vendor) ​Gena Rosati/Laura Londa Dan Reinmund - Refinitiv Cornerstone Comments This is a separate license from our Eikon licenses The service has 2 commercial models, Subscription and Perpetual. The perpetual model is essentially a onetime purchase. Client provides list of instruments, start and end date, fields, frequency and for a one-time fee, we provide a file for you to purchase with a perpetual right to use that data. The subscription model allows a client to subscribe to the service for a minimum of 1 year. You would have access to the front end gui and API with all history for XAU= going back to 1996. You would also be able to access all fields and all frequencies (full tick, minute, 5 minute, etc.). Include Gena Rosati or Laura Londa in any communications and purchases Sample or additional information (including cross references) ​ ​

- S&P DOW JONES INDICES Source https://www.spglobal.com/spdji/en/ How to Cite the Source © 20[xx] S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC Description Historical index constituents and total returns data Time Period Covered Varies by index Access Must purchase and license data directly from S&P Indices Exception: S&P Dow Jones Indices does not license intraday data. That data needs to be licensed directly from exchanges. A limited number of S&P indices are available from Tick Data. Intraday data may be available from CME and/or CBOE Contact: Please go through #Information Resources Cost As of 4/27/2026, $1,000 per year of data for one index, but we should ask for cost estimate for each request. In comparison, a subscription to access the data via LSEG Workspace would entail licensing the full index package that includes our requested index. For example, the DJ US index package is $30,000 per year and does not include history. Important Notes We cannot use data from the S&P Indices web site in our work. Most historical data for S&P indexes has to be licensed directly from S&P Indices. (There might be index price/value data in our other resources like Capital IQ and LSEG Workspace, but you're not likely to find constituents.) Purchasing and licensing data from S&P Indices can take a week, so please plan ahead. There are strict guidelines for licensing the data from S&P Indices, including: The index data must be subject to a Protective Order The amount of data used in the Expert Report must be limited. We can include only limited portions (both in terms of the amount of material obtained from the Services and the proportion of such amount as compared to the volume of content not from the Services within the Subscriber Expert Reports) of historical index values from the Services. S&P will need to verify the Permitted Data is publicly available prior to using it in a report When the matter has concluded, we must cease using the data. Constituent level data may not be reproduced. Opposing side will have to purchase data in order to replicate analysis Subscriber shall include in each Subscriber Expert Report, as it relates to the Permitted Data: (a) a notice indicating that the Permitted Data in the Subscriber Expert Report is only for use in connection with the relevant litigation and (b) the following legend, on behalf of S&P, its affiliates, and its third party licensors: "The [Insert name of applicable S&P index(es)] ("Index(es)") and associated data are a product of S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC, its affiliates and/or their licensors and has been licensed for use by [Subscriber].  © 20[xx] S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC, its affiliates and/or their licensors. All rights reserved. For intended recipient only.  Redistribution or reproduction in whole or in part are prohibited without written permission of S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC. For more information on any of S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC's indices please visit www.spdji.com. S&P® is a registered trademark of Standard & Poor's Financial Services LLC ("SPFS") and Dow Jones® is a registered trademark of Dow Jones Trademark Holdings LLC ("Dow Jones"). Neither S&P Dow Jones Indices LLC, SPFS, Dow Jones, their affiliates nor their licensors ("S&P DJI") make any representation or warranty, express or implied, as to the ability of any index to accurately represent the asset class or market sector that it purports to represent and S&P DJI shall have no liability for any errors, omissions, or interruptions of any index or the data included therein.  In no event shall S&P DJI be liable for any damages, including, without limitation, direct and indirect damages in connection with any use of the Index(es)." AI Restrictions ​Content accessible only through authentication may not be used to train any machine learning or artificial intelligence system, whether obtained through automated or manual means. AI Definitions/Capabilities For Website Content, S&P Global may use generative artificial intelligence ("AI") in two ways: (1) to create and process Website Content, and (2) through interactive features such as chatbots and conversational AI assistants. Our AI capabilities provide targeted industry analyses, market insights, and business intelligence. While our coverage continues to expand, certain specialized data and assessments may not be currently available. Published Content created or processed using AI is composed, reviewed, edited, and approved by S&P Global personnel. S&P Global claims full copyright ownership of all AI-assisted content, in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. Real-time chat responses are generated without human review. Due to the nature of AI technology, responses may contain errors, omissions, inaccuracies, hallucinations, biases, inconsistencies, or outdated information. You must independently verify all content before use, and any reliance on such content is entirely at your own risk. S&P Global and its affiliates do not accept any responsibility or liability for decisions made based on any AI-assisted or AI-generated Content or interactions, whether in contract, tort (including negligence and negligent misstatement), or otherwise. You may not attempt to reverse engineer our AI systems, and we may update features without notice. Conversations may be recorded and user feedback will be collected to improve service performance. - CRIKIT Every Individual in Every Role Is Essential to and Entrusted with the Success of Cornerstone Research. CRIKIT is the Cornerstone Research resource for the development and preservation of intellectual capital.   All employees are invited to use and contribute to this firm wide resource. Some material may be inappropriate for a public content management system.   We expect contributions to be consistent with our core values, emphasize respect, and exhibit high quality. Content should be peer reviewed whenever practical before publishing to CRIKIT.  Content is intended for internal use only and should not be copied, printed, or used for external purposes without the approval of the content manager or content author.  Copyright requirements and court, client, and Cornerstone Research imposed requirements with respect to confidentiality must be followed. Cornerstone Research expressly disclaims any implied warranty or representation about the information or accuracy, relevance, timeliness, completeness, or appropriateness for any particular purpose of any kind presented on CRIKIT. The information presented on CRIKIT is submitted by third parties, is provided only as courtesy, reference and/or resource and does not imply, directly or indirectly, Cornerstone Research's endorsement, sponsorship or approval of the information, nor does any of the information reflect the opinions, analyses, positions, standards or policies of Cornerstone Research, any of its employees, or any expert supported by Cornerstone Research.+ Information Resources Practice Areas and Working Groups Accounting Practice Area UK/EU Practice Group Recent Drop Off Library

- Argus Vickers Source Argus Vickers How to Cite the Source Argus Vickers Description Reporters of institutional & individual equity ownership of UK Public Listed Companies (PLC) and Limited Companies traded on the LSE, AIM and Aquis markets. Time Period Covered 2002 to present Access For custom requests, email #informationresources Contact IR has contacts Cost Approximately £200-£300 (most likely outdated) Important Notes UK law requires full disclosure of stock ownership in the form of the Share Register, listing number of shares held, a name, and an account designation.  Most often, the name on the share register is not the actual owner but a "share registrar", the organization appointed to keep the company's register of shareholders updated.  Argus Vickers works with share registrars to discover the ultimate shareholder. - BranDwatch Source Brandwatch How to Cite the Source Brandwatch Consumer Research Description Brandwatch is a leading provider of social and business analytics software that enables major enterprises to answer critical business questions using insights derived from social and enterprise data. Powered by a broad array of patented analytics technologies and the largest library of social data in the market with more than 750 billion posts, Brandwatch's platform is used by hundreds of leading global organizations. Cornerstone has access to Brandwatch's Consumer Research product . Brandwatch Consumer Research gives subscribers access to the world’s largest archive of consumer opinions from 100 million online sources and over 1.4 trillion posts. In addition to its pooled data, Brandwatch employs proprietary data crawlers allowing fast integration of new data resulting in 496 million new posts available every day. Insights can be extracted with powerful analytics tools and advanced AI, which help to build a better understanding of markets and consumers. The Consumer Research platform allows subscribers to track conversation about brands or topics on social media (X (Twitter), Facebook, blogs, forums, news) and the rest of the web. It can be used, for example, to find mentions of a brand, determine the sentiment surrounding the brand online, find influential conversations, or to track a specific campaign. Following are some helpful pages from Brandwatch's documentation: What is Brandwatch Consumer Research.pdf Brandwatch Consumer Research Coverage.pdf (please see Important Notes below for limitations on Reddit data output) Data Coverage FAQs.pdf (includes timestamps information) Metadata for Each Network.pdf Historical Data.pdf How Brandwatch Gathers Data.pdf FAQs for Consumer Research APIs.pdf (only DSC has access to the Brandwatch API) Here is a vendor demonstration of the Consumer Research product: Demo Video of Brandwatch Time Period Covered Varies by network (see Brandwatch Consumer Research Coverage document above) Access Contact #Information Resources Contact #Information Resources Cost Cost for one month of access per case team: 1-3 active queries and up to 3 users = $2,000 4- 6 active queries and up to 4 ausers = $4,000 7- 9 active queries and up to 4 users = $6,000 10-12 active queries and up to 4 users = $8,000 * Teams can create unlimited queries, but active ones are limited to thresholds above because Cornerstone only has so many available One-off queries run by IR: $250 per inquiry - billed by query not by content source. Data would be both volume summary stats and also raw posts (up to 5,000) matching your search term. Must be a discretely defined one-off query in terms of date parameter, social media sources requested, and keyword query If raw post search results are requested, these should not exceed 5,000 posts (our daily limit is 100,000 total/50,000 for Twitter) Important Notes Our Twitter export limit is 50,000 (firm-wide, per day).  We get a total of 100k exports per day into CSV (up to 50,000 Twitter mentions). Please reach out to #Brandwatch Users to coordinate large exports. Important changes to Reddit data usage in Brandwatch Due to a Reddit Terms of Service update, Brandwatch must now redact certain fields in API responses and exports. You can still view Reddit posts and comments within the Brandwatch platform. You cannot export or distribute Reddit post text, comments, or author names outside of Brandwatch. Previous reports using Reddit data are not affected, but please ensure recently downloaded data is not used in external deliverables. For questions or concerns, contact Thomas Powell (Legal), Gena Rosati (Information Resources), and Mark D'Agostino (Data Science Center). See the Reddit Compliance – Consumer Research.pdf for a full list of affected fields. Brandwatch was formerly known as Crimson Hexagon. AI Restrictions At Cornerstone we Cannot use Brandwatch data to "train, develop, enhance, or contribute to any generative artificial intelligence models, machine learning models, or any form of algorithmic or software-based artificial intelligence systems" without pre-approval from Brandwatch. Brandwatch's Service Appendix AI Definitions/Capabilities Definition of Artificial Intelligence : "intelligence displayed by machines, in contrast with the natural intelligence displayed by humans and other animals." IRIS : AI tool created by Brandwatch that "automatically analyzes your data and spots any significant spike... It then reads all of the metrics and tries to discover the key drivers of conversation." Uses social media, newsletters, to get data Compares this to 20 days of historical data to see spike in brand usage Presents data clear and simple on right hand side of the screen Runs search on all of your data over every spike Part of already existing platform Way to benchmark, check your work, and be more time efficient React Score : AI-powered tool that identifies "online conversations that could impact your brand reputation" Updated 8/6/2026_hg+ BranDwatch Source Brandwatch How to Cite the Source Brandwatch Consumer Research Description Brandwatch is a leading provider of social and business analytics software that enables major enterprises to answer critical business questions using insights derived from social and enterprise data. - ​(20090204) Out with the old and in with the new.  Announcing the new IR Wiki/Portal Site From: Londa, Laura To: #Cornerstone Research < CornerstoneResearch@cornerstone.com > Hello everyone, As a result of suggestions from you all and our own desire to more easily update our information for your use, we have merged our portal page with our new Crikit site ( http://crikit/Information_Resources ).  If you go to the Information Resources Community on the portal, you will now see our Crikit site embedded there.  With Crikit, we were able to create a site that was more dynamic and able to handle many more types and forms of information. However we did not want to entirely abandon the portal as we know many people turn to it first, and we found that certain portal-specific applications could not be brought over.  Thus to access CRSP or to add yourself to one of our TOC Routing lists, you will still need to go to the portal. However I think you will really like some of the new things we have added to our new site. A few of the more interesting things you will find are Updated pricing list for the data we download Complete copies of the Institutional Investor's All-American Research Team articles from 1990 to present and broken out by year and by industry! Detailed information on all of the outside data sources that Cornerstone uses (including costs and how to source them). (Please feel free to add your own comments on the source as well or add new sources to the list.) FAQ with answers to commonly asked IR questions like time stamps, NAICS and SIC codes, Factiva Sources, etc. Searching tips and tricks for the databases you have access to And much, much more! And if you think there is something missing, don't hesitate to let us know.  We can easily add and update everything.  With this new site, we will be continuing to add new information and resources for you.  At the top of the main page you will see the latest announcements regarding changes to the page or to our resources.  So come on in and look around and let us know what you think.  ( http://crikit/Information_Resources ). Long Live Crikit! --Information Resources Laura L. Londa Director of Information Resources Cornerstone Research 353 Sacramento Street, 23rd Floor San Francisco, CA  94111 Direct Dial:  415-229-8153 Fax:  415-229-8199 Email: llonda@cornerstone.com http://www.cornerstone.com
